meta.title: Telecom Engineer
meta.tagline: Design and operate the networks that connect the world.
meta.description: Telecom engineers design, deploy and manage telecommunications infrastructure — cellular networks, fiber optic systems, satellite communications and broadband networks.

details.description: Telecom engineers design, deploy and manage telecommunications infrastructure — cellular networks, fiber optic systems, satellite communications and broadband networks.
details.whyLearn: Design and operate the networks that connect the world. Telecom engineers design, deploy and manage telecommunications infrastructure — cellular networks, fiber optic systems, satellite communications and broadband networks.
objectives: Build a complete foundation in telecom engineer
Complete hands-on projects for your portfolio
interviewQuestions: Why do you want to become a telecom engineer?
Walk me through a project you're proud of

details.careerRelevance: Telecom Engineer is a High demand career with typical salaries of $75k-$140k+.
tips: Follow this roadmap in order
Build and publish projects at every stage
Join communities and network
